synopsis: The glossary identifies blind prediction as an engineering counterpart to a pilot, alongside a “walking skeleton,” or crude end-to-end chain [f16403]. Chapter 12 gives blind prediction in the Sandia Fracture Challenges as a concrete analogue for a pilot or proof of concept [f9907]. For the virtual-validation pilot, it recommends running simulations before physical results are seen; this is expert guidance, not evidence of a completed pilot or its performance [f9918].

relations.note: Sandia Fracture Challenges provides a specific example of the glossary’s pilot analogue.
Specifies how blind prediction should be applied in a virtual-validation pilot.
